verdict.rationale: GitCafe documents a first-class Buildkite integration: builds appear on a CI tab and as pull-request checks, and results can be published to GitHub for synced repos. Signed webhooks fire on pushes and merges, personal access tokens are explicitly meant for CI jobs, and rulesets can require passing checks, which together let external CI drive the workflow. Missing for 10: documented integrations for CI tools beyond Buildkite (e.g. Jenkins, CircleCI), an explicitly documented generic commit-status/checks API for arbitrary CI systems, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
